text:
maria: morning all — need a final decision for GA scope on Dedicated capacity. customers keep asking for predictable burst behavior and clear billing. we can't ship vague promises.
oliver: short summary from infra: we can deliver pool-level burst bands quickly. per-tenant guaranteed lanes require quota manager + reservation API; that's heavier.
tara: product POV: customers asked for three things: predictable tail latency, a simple billing model, and a way to guarantee capacity during launches. would like tiered defaults we can advertise.
evan: runtime caveat: when tenants spill to opportunistic lanes, their KV cache is cold. tail latency can jump for multiple minutes. we need prewarm or a time-boxed grace to avoid repeated high-95p events.
maria: my working proposal: define Burst Tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) that map to behavior and billing. Bronze = pool soft-band (best-effort), Silver = timed credits (measured) + pilot onboarding, Gold = reserved headroom + SLA. Bronzeship should be the GA default.
oliver: implementation notes: for Bronze we ship a per-pool soft multiplier + auto-throttle if latency rises. config we can ship asap:
```yaml
burst_pool:
  soft_multiplier: 3
  auto_throttle_threshold_95p: 2.0
  auto_throttle_cooldown_s: 600
```
tara: billing question: how do we reflect Silver credits? customers hate opaque charges. finance prefers hourly alignment with a clear reconciliation window.
finance-bot: recommendation from finance: hourly reconciliation, show credit usage on invoice line items, cap carryover to 2x hourly allocation to avoid indefinite accumulation.
evan: runtime suggestion for Silver: implement credit buckets as leaky buckets on pools, plus a short prewarm token that covers KV-warmup (e.g., 10k tokens) per spill event. that reduces tail while we scale.
maria: also propose a "probation window" for Silver pilots — 30 days where opt-in tenants get credits and we monitor impact before we offer auto-billing.
oliver: safety controls: add circuit-breaker that if 95p > 3x baseline for 5m, instantly disable opportunistic spill for that pool for 15m and notify oncall. also emit an event to autoscaler to prefer pinned capacity for that tenant.
tara: contract copy draft: "Bronze: pool-level soft-burst to absorb short spikes (best-effort). Silver: measured burst credits, pilot-only. Gold: reserved headroom available as add-on with SLA." legal sign-off pending.
finance-bot: ticket CREATED: BILL-9001 "Dedicated: burst tiers billing and hourly reconciliation" assigned to @evan
ops-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-9002 "Dedicated: Bronze defaults + safety circuit" assigned to @oliver
evan: timeline: Bronze defaults + circuit-breaker + telemetry = 1 sprint. Silver credit engine + prewarm tokens + billing hooks = 2 sprints. Gold reservation API + SLA onboarding = GA+2.
maria: decision call: ship Bronze for GA with explicit telemetry and the circuit-breaker. offer Silver as pilot via opt-in CS flow (probation 30d) and defer automated billing and carryover dashboard to GA+1. Gold reserved headroom will be a paid add-on roadmap item. owners: oliver (infra), evan (runtime + billing hook prototype), tara (product & contracts). agreement?
oliver: yes.
tara: yes.
evan: yes, will draft design doc for Silver in PROD-9002.
maria: i'll update public roadmap entry and the customer FAQ. final note: GA must not enable auto-billing for burst; customers must explicitly opt-in to Silver pilot."
